reuse.why: Reuses setBudget, getSheetValue, isTrackingBudget, batchMessages and the mutator/undoable wiring, but the tree has no shared category-selection helper and the change pastes the selection SQL again instead of extracting one.

duplication.why: The eligible-category SQL (hidden, hidden group, goal_def) is the fifth verbatim copy, and the income-skip guard and expense sign flip are copied from set3MonthAvg.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts with the same wrappers.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Reads like its siblings, but any future change to which categories month-wide actions touch now has to be repeated in five SQL copies plus copyPreviousMonth.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared selection abstraction exists in this tree to bypass; it uses the existing setBudget/getSheetValue primitives.

disguised_duplication.where: The category SQL and the income/sign logic in setLastMonthSpending (budget/actions.ts) are plain copies of setZero/set3MonthAvg.
